title: A fixed column count in a criterion needs a grid that cannot grow past it
rule: When a criterion or design names a column count ("a two-column grid"), do not use `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(<px>, 1fr))` alone: the count then follows the container width and grows on wide windows, because the family page's main column has no maximum width. Cap it: give each track a minimum of at least 1/N of the width (`minmax(max(<px>, calc((100% - (N-1) * gap) / N)), 1fr)`) or use a fixed `repeat(N, minmax(0, 1fr))` with a narrow breakpoint. Add a Playwright check at 1366, 1920 and 2560 px wide that asserts the row and column of each item, and one at a narrow width.
rationale: E42.8 (#459): the Info section's four groups were two columns at 1280 px but three at 1366 and four at 1920; the only layout test ran at 1280 px.
